visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). The index.html in this directory is the RETIRED KB-era mockup and is kept only because ci:mockup-coverage requires a parity.json beside any index.html. It is not the visual target for this route any more. The target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. Sell opens Stage then Sheet.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic list-with-us pages: the ask in the first working surface (SellerLPForm, Places autocomplete, pagePath=/sell), live Bend figures with a source trace, one 3% plan with the full Enhanced inclusion list, and every valuation CTA anchored to #get-value. Zero invented results. D11: Value my home / Get your home's value, never What's my home worth on a control.
note: Migrated off the KB register onto the v3 barrel 2026-08-13 (E-SELL). Rhythm: four of the six patterns, no two adjacent alike, chrome exempt. Order is Breadcrumb (on-media), Stage (H1 Sell your home in Central Oregon, primary Value my home), Sheet-equivalent SellCapture wrapping SellerLPForm (capture contract unchanged), Instrument level 2 (Bend pulse, ghost Value my home), V3Sheet (3% plan, Enhanced inclusions, no matrix), Quiet (FAQ + track-record prose + verbatim Google reviews + doors), Footer outside main. The verdict classifies the RAW months-of-supply value and the screen prints formatMonthsOfSupply. Track-record figures do not share the Bend pulse source line. KB-era deletions: KbHero, KbBreadcrumb, KbFooter, KbTestimonials, SmoothScrollProvider, LifestyleStrip, CTABar, FAQBlock, SellProof sold-story cards, SellValueProps, SellerSituations, SellProcess, SellPlanSingle, SellCommission, SellMarketContext, SellValuationCTA, the sticky mobile bar, and the same-broker / no hand-off FAQ. Eight sell/* modules plus LifestyleStrip (last importer was /sell) were orphaned by the page rewrite and deleted in this commit. Capture is not a deletion: SellerLPForm still posts the same payload with pagePath=/sell and formId get-value.

requiredComponents.name: KbNav
requiredComponents.section: The public header, mounted by app/layout.tsx through V3Chrome. Not a page-level import; ci:mockup-parity auto-satisfies this entry while the layout owns the header. Chrome already landed (E-CHROME).

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics, pageType='sell'. Kept on the KB register deliberately: section tracking is analytics wiring, not visual language, and the barrel ships no equivalent.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: JSON-LD BreadcrumbList + FAQPage. V3Breadcrumb and V3Quiet carry no structured data of their own. FAQPage items are the same FAQ_ITEMS array the Quiet block renders.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home / Sell. tone=on-media because the page opens on a dark V3Stage (ci:kb-breadcrumb-overlay).

requiredComponents.name: V3Stage
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 4, opens the page. headingLevel 1, height compact so H1 clears chrome and the address step shares the first 390 viewport. H1 is the seo-shell head term. Action label Value my home, ghost, href #get-value. The filled primary is the capture submit.

requiredComponents.name: SellerLPForm
requiredComponents.section: The ask. Two-step seller form (Places autocomplete, partial-lead, CMA queue). pagePath='/sell' attribution. formId anchor #get-value. Capture contract unchanged.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, level 2 (Stage already emitted the h1). Bend pulse figures, each a door, under the Bend pulse trace. Ask is ghost Value my home.

requiredComponents.name: V3Sheet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 5, the one 3% plan as plan-detail blocks. No field, no matrix, no 2.5/3.5. Enhanced inclusions only.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6. Seller FAQ as prose from the same FAQ_ITEMS the FAQPage JSON-LD uses, track-record proof as prose with its own MLS closed-sale trace, verbatim Google reviews, outbound doors including Value my home and valuationHref('/sell').

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. No button. Rendered OUTSIDE main.

layoutComponents.name: V3Chrome
layoutComponents.note: Landed E-CHROME. Not remounted on this page.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes. Using it here would compete with /homes-for-sale and would push the page to five patterns.

deferredComponents.name: V3Ledger
deferredComponents.reason: Sold-story cards used to be a third proof rail. Rhythm allows four patterns. Proof now lives as Instrument figures plus Quiet prose. A Ledger of sold homes would be a fifth pattern.

required.emittedBy: MetadataBlock schemas array (faqPage entry), items = the same FAQ_ITEMS array V3Quiet renders

jsonLd.note: One derivation for the FAQ. Visible Quiet answers and FAQPage items are the same array. No Dataset on this route (the KB page never emitted one).

dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts. market_pulse_live, geo_type='city', geo_slug='bend', property_type='A'. Feeds the Instrument.
dataLayer.getSurfaceImage: lib/data/media/getSurfaceImages.ts. Distinct approved hero for /sell, fallback tetherow-golf-aerial. Feeds V3Stage posterSrc. No homepage Old Mill video on this route: a Stage with a poster is complete, and /sell was already on a distinct still so it would not reuse the homepage banner.
dataLayer.getBrokerageTrackRecord: lib/data/track-record.ts. Closed Ryan Realty list-side sales. Feeds Quiet proof prose, not the Bend Instrument.
dataLayer.SellerLPForm: app/lp/seller-home-value/SellerLPForm.tsx into app/lp/seller-home-value/actions.ts. Bound to SellCapture. Same action, same payload, same field names, pagePath=/sell.
dataLayer.note: Every read is a DAL function from @/lib/data (G8). Nothing is fetched that the page does not render. getCityMarketDetail, getLifestyleImages, and getSoldStories were dropped with the sections that consumed them. Route-local constants live in app/sell/_v3/sell-constants.ts.
